questions.stem_text: Explain why the opportunity for unions to increase the demand for labor is limited.

options.B: Unions can directly control employment rates nationally
options.C: Unions are the primary drivers of economic growth and thereby increase labor demand
options.D: Unions can significantly increase labor demand
options.E: Unions have limited means to influence the demand for labor

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: E - Unions have limited means to influence the demand for labor

questions.stem_text: The appropriate fiscal policy to remedy inflation calls for

options.A: decreased government spending and increased taxes.
options.B: the federal government to decrease the money supply.
options.C: the federal government to run a deficit.
options.D: decreased taxes and increased government spending.
options.E: the federal government to increase the money supply.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - decreased government spending and increased taxes.

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following examples would result in consumers paying for the largest burden of
an excise tax placed on a producer?

options.A: If both the demand and supply curves are price inelastic
options.B: If the demand curve is perfectly elastic and the supply curve is perfectly inelastic
options.C: If the demand curve is price inelastic and the supply curve is price elastic
options.D: If both the demand and supply curves are price elastic
options.E: If the demand curve is price elastic and the supply curve is price inelastic

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - If both the demand and supply curves are price inelastic

questions.stem_text: What is meant by the term marginal costs?

options.A: the cost of all produced units
options.B: the fixed cost associated with the production facility
options.D: the cost of initial unit of production
options.E: the additional cost of one more unit of production

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: E - the additional cost of one more unit of production
